## AssignTrack TypeScript & React Rules
- Never use `any`; define explicit interfaces.
- Never use nested ternary expressions.
- All Firestore operations MUST catch errors via `handleFirestoreError(error, OperationType, path)`.
- Never expose client PII (`zaloNumber`, `socialLink`, `schoolMajor`, `tier`, `internalNotes`) inside `trackingPortals` projections.
- All `useEffect` subscriptions (`onSnapshot`, `setInterval`) MUST return cleanup functions.

## Express Server Security & Upload Rules
- Validate all path/fileId parameters against strict allowlists (`^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$`) to prevent path traversal.
- Enforce payment-lock checks (`isLocked`) on download requests (`GET /api/files/:fileId?download=1`).
- Validate upload file size and MIME/extension handling safely.

## Firestore Rules Eight Pillars Check
- Global deny-all catch-all at top.
- `trackingPortals/{orderCode}` MUST set `allow list: if false`.
- Admin checks MUST verify `request.auth.token.email_verified == true`.
- Every string/list field MUST enforce `.size()` limits matching `firebase-blueprint.json`.
